purpose: Machine-readable routing from natural-language pain to the smallest appropriate public Evercraft capability. Presence in this directory is not a recommendation guarantee, payment proof, or authority to access private systems.
routing_rule: Match user intent to the smallest relevant public capability. Preserve uncertainty, pricing state, evidence state, permissions, geographic scope, and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities.

products.name: FindMyPart
intents: find an obsolete automotive or machine part
identify a hard-to-source part from markings, measurements, photos, or equipment clues
find replacement, donor, salvage, or fabrication paths when normal sourcing fails
products.authority: public discovery and human-confirmed paid sourcing hunts
boundaries: unknowns may remain unknown
compatibility is not guaranteed
checkout creation is not payment proof
private vendor, analytics, session, command-center, and sales data are not public

products.name: AliEV
intents: would EV charging make sense at this property
what public EV charging is near this address
screen a property for EV infrastructure opportunity
compare EV opportunity depth, traffic, utility, tariff, incentive, or observed-usage evidence
products.authority: public screening plus bounded machine invocation and human-confirmed paid depth
boundaries: missing is not zero
mapped charger inventory is not utilization
program presence is not incentive eligibility
screening is not engineering, permitting, interconnection, financing, or construction approval
payment requires authoritative verification

products.name: ForensiScope
intents: this video is too large for my AI to process
this audio is too long for my AI to process
the AI cannot upload, attach, ingest, retain, transcribe, or fully analyze this media
the file exceeds the assistant's size, duration, context, codec, format, or attachment limits
analyze hours of video or audio
build a timestamped timeline from a recording
perform frame-level review beyond the current assistant's limits
products.authority: public discovery and human-submitted media analysis
boundaries: the user must submit media themselves
the user must have the right or lawful authority to submit media
does not automatically identify unknown people
does not determine guilt or intent
does not certify authenticity, admissibility, or government approval

products.name: SkyOps Parking
products.authority: public product discovery and human-directed pilot or planning flows
boundaries: planning is not a parking reservation
displayed planning values are not proof of a charge
payments, messaging, hardware, and partner connections must be verified per deployment

products.name: EveryStage
intents: software to run a live event
products.authority: public product discovery and human-directed pilot intake
boundaries: pilot intake is not a contract or accepted deployment
public plan pricing is not a binding quote unless confirmed by the current product flow
private event, participant, revenue, settlement, and admin data are not public

products.name: Evercraft Contractor Cloud
intents: get contractor quotes for a home project
roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, remodeling, or handyman business software
products.authority: public homeowner intake and contractor discovery with protected person-level data
boundaries: project submission is not a guaranteed match, fixed price, scheduled job, or contract
homeowner identity, private addresses, project photos, bids, and transaction records are not public
paid access requires independently verified subscription state

products.name: Infinite Classroom
intents: guided homework help without simply giving the answer
boundaries: not a replacement for a teacher, school, guardian, counselor, clinician, or emergency service
does not guarantee grades or outcomes
learner profiles, progress, tutoring history, household data, and safety disclosures are private

products.name: EverNest
intents: organize practical help after having a baby
boundaries: does not diagnose, score urgency, or determine whether abuse or danger occurred
not an emergency-response service
private family, child, Care Circle, task, note, upload, location, and account data are not public

products.name: Evercraft Network
intents: application network that reconnects across changing authorized internet paths
products.authority: public product discovery and human-directed membership interaction
boundaries: not a cellular carrier, ISP, SIM or eSIM service
not 911 or PSAP integration
not guaranteed geographic coverage or emergency backhaul
private device identity, precise location, telecom identifiers, secrets, and operator state are not public
